svg.text: Immich: hard storage quotas while uploads are streaming
Concurrent uploads can each pass the quota check against the same old usage, and a dead API process leaves half-written originals on disk. The agent makes the
per-user quota a hard limit across separate API processes and the background worker.
counts bytes as they arrive and refuses
drops a stream before it ends
half a MiB every 5 s for 35 s
shared by every process; originals land
third 4 MiB upload: committed plus in flight would pass 10 MiB
within 45 s, with no new request: the partial original leaves
GET /api/users/me shows committed usage only. A client abort frees its space within 5 seconds; deleting an original releases its usage exactly once.
illustrative sizes: a quota 10 MiB above current usage
